full_reads: All three exact donor files from immutable GitHub source.
Current testpilot/html_report.py and testpilot/__init__.py from the exact integration base.
findings: New saved-report entry imports the existing renderer and adds a provenance section at its unchanged single container marker. It does not dispatch a model, runner or patch application; package imports remain those of current TestPilot.
Bounded file-descriptor reads require regular files; POSIX nonblocking admission avoids waiting on a FIFO. Strict report decoding rejects duplicate and nonfinite values before rendering.

Patch matching is exact recorded UTF-8 or the explicitly documented native Windows LF-expansion form. The selected raw report and patch bytes are passed to the unchanged renderer and remain the embedded downloads.

Current renderer escapes literal content, uses static local CSS and data-URI downloads, and its container marker remains compatible. Supported layout failures are controlled without widening the report into an execution input.

New output uses a completed/fsynced temporary file and exclusive hard link; occupied destinations, cleanup failure after publication and hard-link support limits are documented without claiming durable atomic source snapshots.

Eight maintained methods meaningfully cover actual archived pairs and optimized child calls, passive renderer equivalence, malformed/mismatched inputs, literal data, destination races and ordinary recovery. No redundant runtime was run during this review.
Only the three donor additions belong in the product overlay. Existing current renderer, package init, generation writer, README, workflow and all unrelated source stay exact.
